providers.risk: One-time tariff refunds of €200 million partly inflated recent margins; any shift in consumer discretionary spending could dampen the premium valuation.

providers.market_view: The German market faces a challenging opening as the DAX struggles to overcome its 50-day moving average, a key medium-term technical resistance.
